manifest.meaning: Existing catalogue cafés within40m straight-line of the original named OSM way geometry. Not a walking route, entrance, safe crossing, frontage or recommendation.
manifest.duplicates: One café may be near multiple ways, parallel roads or intersection segments. Counts must not be added as unique cafés. OSM way segments with the same name remain separate.
manifest.eligibility: Named street/walkway classes; excludes motorways/trunks/construction/proposed and explicit private/no/customers access or foot restrictions. Unknown access is not permission.
manifest.selection: Top300 ways by cafe count, independent count, then lexical OSM way ID, plus highest-ranked way covering each otherwise-unrepresented Bangkok district; max350 and500000bytes
